headline: Weathered Expanse Heaviest as Three Sectors Shift Colors
war_summary: Three sectors have shifted in the colors since the morning edition, and the heaviest fighting continues in the Weathered Expanse. That sector now reads four Warden posts to five Colonial, narrowing the Colonial margin reported earlier, with thirty-seven events logged in the past day and four in the last two hours. Callahan's Passage stands at eight Warden to two Colonial, the Colonials having gained ground since the last filing; Stlican Shelf reads three Warden, five Colonial and one ruined post; and Nevish Line now shows six Warden to two Colonial with no neutral ground remaining. Stonecradle holds at seven Colonial to two Warden, Linn Mercy remains wholly Colonial at eleven posts, and Mooring County remains entirely Warden at twelve. In the past two hours ten events were recorded across four sectors: four in the Weathered Expanse, three in Callahan's Passage, two on Stlican Shelf and one on Nevish Line. The day's casualty ledgers are heaviest in the Weathered Expanse, Callahan's Passage, Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle and Nevish Line. No victor has been declared.
